1. This mod let you [[]#ffff00]customize[[]] [[]#ffff00]Casual[[]] Difficulty in [[]#00ffff]game setting[[]] also make other Difficulty [[]#ff0000]harder[[]]

	3. Mark all serpulo vanilla [[]#ff0000]enemy base[[]] sector with icon

	[[]#ff0080]WARNING this mod will overwrite icon on all serpulo vanilla enemy base sector and can't be turn off[[]]
	
	[[]#ff0000]Check out my other Anser mod name[[]]
